pages.title: Trust
pages.text: Trust is serene and inviting, until you break its laws of Hospitality. It is populated by typhlotic endermen called $(bold)guests$(). Hospitality holds them back from attacking, but they can still sense eye contact and will make their way towards you peacefully if looked at.

The rules of Trust are as follows:$(br2)Do not harm a guest.$(br2)Do not pick the flowers or fell the trees that grow here.$(br2)Share your meals; do not eat unless you've given a guest some food in the past minute.$(br2)If you break any of these laws, the guests have permission to attack you, and they will.
